notes.title: Autumn Game Update
notes.content: New updates and bug fixes and optimizations. New Band Tour interface and character select screen.

notes.title: New Update New Features
notes.content: Many updates and bug fixes and new Character Selection screen.

notes.title: Holiday 2024 Update
notes.content: Fixed some bugs, added some Holiday fun to the mix. Enjoy.

notes.title: Thanksgiving Update
notes.content: This is an update for Thanksgiving holidays. Some mini-games to play and bug fixes and optimizations.

notes.title: Update for October 2024
notes.content: Updates and Halloween Time 2024.

notes.title: Easter Update
notes.content:
It's that time again, the Great Easter Egg hunt is on! Climb the leaderboards with your super Egg hunting skillszzzzz. The Bunny might have left something in the store also.  And the bunny was hard at work optimizing stuff so it runs better. So you can blame the bunny is it doesn't work, or maybe it was the Leprechauns from St. Patrick's day that left gremlins around. If you see any send in a report and we will clean it right up. :)
Have fun.

notes.title: St. Patrick's Update
notes.content:
The Green Holiday is upon us. There is Gold at the end of the Rainbow, if you can keep those little Leprechauns from hiding it all. Enjoy the Holiday surprises.
Also added cross platform characters so you can login on different devices with the same character and keep your stats and all.
Optimized some levels.

notes.title: Jan-Feb Update
notes.content:
New year awaits your game play. Join in the fun. Improvements and updates. Classroom functions for schools to connect and play together. 
Game name changed.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Updates
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with Friends and players coming and going. Added Person to unlock Friends button in main Hub for now. Fixed issue with logging in when account is not valid. Changed saving clothes to save to proper files and fixed network issues for changing clothes.
Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Small Halloween update patch.
notes.content: Made the main Hub a little more spooky. Also check out the NPC on the stage, he can tell you how to become a Rockstar!

notes.title: Halloween 2023 Update
notes.content: It's that time of year again! It's the fun Halloween party update! Get costumes and go to spooky Transylvania!  Do the Spooktober quest in the main Hub to get your ticket for the Party!

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.content: Bug Fix for a Tutorial Issue

notes.title: September Patch 1.0
notes.content: Added a new select server box for other world servers for testing. Bug fixes.

notes.title: September Update
notes.content:
Bug fixes, Server connection fixes. Game updates.
September Update. A new obstacle course has been started in the HUB, try it out.

notes.title: August Update
notes.content: Game Improvements, bug fixes and updates. New store items.

notes.title: July Patch Notes
notes.content: Added a new Mini Map System. You will now more easily be able to find quest items in the general area. Also new quest givers. Bug fixes.

notes.title: Updates and July 4th Event
notes.content:
Lots of updates, bug fixes and some changes.
Added a Todo Task popup, so you can more easily see what you need to do next.
Added new NPCs that you will ask you questions to answer, in 7 different categories. IN different levels.
Added music playing NPCs so you can go up and play music with them, they each have their own instrument to play.
New July 4th items and fire works you can buy and use.
More quest givers in certain levels.

notes.title: Fix crashing bug
notes.content: Fixed crashing bug.

notes.title: Fixes and Updates! Some new Content also!
notes.content:
There are several updates to this. 
1. You can unlock the On Screen Piano in New York. Talk to NPC.
2. You can unlock the Riff Sequencer in Santa Monica
3. You can Unlock Band Tours in Paris (Might not all be working and saving out yet.)
4. You can Unlock Whistle Quests, by talking to Strad. Start in Peru, but you can talk to any of them. The Quests are not all done, so can do them, but you can see them. (Will change as they are implemented)
5. There are now Free NPC's that will give you quests around. (Some parts might be broken, or not saving.) Can always just go to a new level to clean up stuff.
6. The Easter Egg hunt Event is over, and there is a new Clean up event (Was for Earth Day), but its still using the Eggs. So I guess that kinda works. :)
7. Bug fixes and other updates to clean up some stuff.

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes
notes.content: Fixed mini concert tutorial and camera stuck on NPCs. cleaned up some bugs and code.

notes.title: Wall climbing areas fixed.
notes.content:
Fixed some areas where you could climb the walls or get stuck. 
Added Whistle Quests Descriptions, when you talk to Strad the Violin in the 5 levels.

notes.title: Easter Event Patch and Bug fixes
notes.content:
Easter is here and so is Easter Egg hunting. Join in the fun and find the most easter eggs. Get the top score on the Leaderboards. Go to the hub to play the Easter Egg Hunt event.
Also added Map zoom. made it easier to select flags and a popup list of countries to use, you can find the button on the map.
Added some Easter items in the store. 
Fixed some bugs.
Scroll text is now added to the dialog boxes.

notes.title: Bug Fix Updates
notes.content:
Fixed some travel quests not ending. Fixed some item locations and sizes for quests. 
Added more descriptive text for quests.

notes.title: Added Feedback Popup
notes.content: Added a Bugs and Feedback popup.

notes.content:
Updates and Fixes for many items.
